models.purpose: Fail-closed dependency/readiness gate for explicitly declared positive-life research fixtures.
models.fidelity: FORMAL contract semantics over approximate/empirical inputs
models.validityDomain: Only the declared biochemistry profile and supplied environment packet.
assumptions: Positive life is explicitly seeded post-genesis
Media, energy, nutrient and redox requirements are profile-specific inputs
models.uncertainty: Scientific validity inherits each packet field's source metadata; readiness is not occupancy or habitability proof.

models.purpose: Bounded deterministic population/ecology/evolution research state machine.
models.fidelity: MEDIUM for bookkeeping/conservation; LOW-to-STYLIZED for synthetic evolutionary dynamics
models.validityDomain: Explicit seeded research fixtures with declared rates, capacities, resource budgets and interaction parameters.
assumptions: Vital rates are per-step explicit inputs
Density suppression is a stylized carrying-capacity term
Trophic and dispersal fractions act on pre-step abundance
All interaction efficiencies are supplied, never universal constants
models.uncertainty: No calibration to a general Earth ecosystem or extraterrestrial biosphere; no claim of ecosystem stability, coextinction probability, or predictive macroevolution.

models.purpose: Research event identity and replay semantics subordinate to P4 temporal ownership.
models.validityDomain: Deterministic serialization/event application in this research model.
assumptions: P4 supplies accepted event order and operation keys
The biology lane stores no private event log or biological clock
models.uncertainty: Research IDs are not canonical P2 entity IDs and require a promotion mapping policy.

models.purpose: REFINE/PROJECT/RECONCILE between population aggregates and bounded ephemeral organism samples.
models.fidelity: FORMAL hierarchy semantics; STYLIZED biological content
models.validityDomain: Exact coarse-state snapshots and lineage/population commitments produced by this model.
assumptions: Fine materialization never overrides coarse commitments
models.uncertainty: No anatomy, behavior, genetics, persistent organism identity or alien morphology is predicted.

models.validityDomain: Declared stage graph and supplied vital/transition rates.
assumptions: Rates are fixed for one supplied transition step
models.uncertainty: Stage aggregation can bias demographic quantities; no universal lifecycle graph is claimed.

models.purpose: Portable deterministic mutation-opportunity abstraction using domain-separated SHA-256 and bounded integer trait steps.
models.validityDomain: Synthetic research traits with explicit probability, bounds and P4 operation key.
assumptions: Integer trait step is an abstraction rather than molecular genetics
models.uncertainty: Modulo mapping is deterministic but not claimed as a biological stochastic law; no genotype, recombination or fitness landscape is modeled.

models.purpose: Bounded population-to-environment flux proposal without direct environment mutation authority.
models.validityDomain: Explicit per-individual signed flux coefficients and current aggregate abundance.
assumptions: Feedback coefficients are supplied by a future calibrated model
Upstream environment authority adjudicates any application
models.uncertainty: No feedback coefficient is calibrated here; Earth examples justify the seam but not extraterrestrial magnitude.

numerics.rounding: floor for products/divisions unless an operation rejects
numerics.hash: domain-separated SHA-256 over canonical UTF-8 encoding in the Node research runtime; promoted/browser form must use the OFU browser-safe hash seam while preserving golden vectors
numerics.portabilityPath: Promoted form should preserve byte-level serialization vectors and cross-language oracle equivalence; no floating-point migration is required for the present prototype.

identity.lineagePersistence: Lineage records persist after demographic extinction with an extinction P4 operation key; IDs are never recycled inside a state.
identity.promotionRequirement: Map semantic lineage/population/event keys through a canonical P2-compatible successor identity policy before promotion.

unsupported: abiogenesis probability or spontaneous canonical genesis
universal species-delimitation threshold or speciation rate
molecular genetics, genomes, recombination or genotype-to-fitness mapping
predictive alien anatomy, morphology or behavior
